'''Kerry Williams''' is an American voice actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Williams was born in 1973 and became a voice actress as an adult. She joined {{aniseries|PTS}} in the [[S03|third season]] and provided several voices until [[4Kids Entertainment]] gave up [[Pokémon USA recasting controversy|their rights of the English dub to Pokémon USA]]. Years later, she returned to the series starting in ''[[BW055|Scraggy and the Demanding Gothita!]]'', making her the first former 4Kids voice actor to return to the animated series in {{aniseries|BW}}.
